name: codex-flint
description: High-signal response flint for Codex CLI. Modes plus token budget/context hygiene diagnostics. Inspired by caveman by Julius Brussee.

interface.shortDescription: Flint Codex responses and diagnose token budget waste
interface.longDescription: CODEX-FLINT activates high-signal response flint and includes budget diagnostics and benchmark checks. Modes: lite, full, ultra, wenyan. Budget doctor analyzes Codex session JSONL for input/context bloat, large tool outputs, broad searches, and hook noise. Benchmark compares FLINT against Caveman/RUNES-style ratios and checks ultra retention fixtures. Auto-safety: security warnings and irreversible ops always get full prose.
